light_description: North Macedonian hand-built overdrive with active bass/treble EQ, usable as clean or dirty boost and extending into distortion at higher gain.
North Macedonian analog high-gain distortion with volume, gain, three-band EQ and a three-way gain switch.
North Macedonian analog fuzz with a bias control blending tighter modern fuzz toward vintage octave-fuzz behavior.
Gain-adjacent Jinx preamp/boost retained at the edge of the dirt catalog because the builder places it in the same pedal product universe.
Slovenian handwired Fuzz Face-style fuzz using NOS germanium and external bias control, documented as a 2024 model.
Slovenian handwired Eternity Burst-derived overdrive offered as a preorder/customizable build in 2024.
